payload.detail: Baltic Print revised quote Q-1187-B arrives and replaces original quote Q-1187

payload.claim: Original Baltic quote promised delivery to address by Nov 9, but was later replaced
payload.quote: Delivery: delivered to your address by 9 November.

payload.claim: Revised Baltic quote replaces Q-1187 and promises only warehouse dispatch by Nov 10, not arrival
payload.quote: Delivery: Goods will leave our warehouse by 10 November.

payload.claim: Vestland portal shows Oslo freight full and Bergen van guaranteed Wed Nov 11 08:00-12:00
Baltic shipping terms mean dispatch dates are not guaranteed arrival dates
payload.quote: Delivery dates in quotes refer to dispatch unless the quote states a guaranteed arrival date at your address.

payload.claim: Venue confirmation covers Thursday event only and verifies nothing about Wed Nov 11 deliveries
payload.quote: This confirmation covers the Thursday event only. It says nothing about deliveries on other days.

payload.reason: Q-1187-B replaced Q-1187 at 00:38; per shipping terms it is dispatch-only by Nov 10 with transit not guaranteed, so no verified Baltic arrival for Tue Nov 10 16:00 Oslo deadline. Vestland Oslo freight is full; Bergen van Wed Nov 11 08:00-12:00 is guaranteed by portal but venue receipt for that Wed window is unverified - venue confirms Thursday only and decision_facts venue_delivery_window and recipient_can_receive are null. No verified on-time route would be lost by waiting, and a hold stating recipient yes/venue window would violate standing permission verification rule, so do not wake and defer comparison and drafts to 07:00.
